sentences: Recovery steps start automatically when a SessionUpdate parameter cannot be applied.
They are limited to ten seconds.
If recovery fails, the terminal releases the session and sends a SessionRequest message after one minute.
Recovery was the hardest part to implement.

requirements.text: The terminal shall start the recovery steps automatically when a SessionUpdate parameter cannot be applied.
The recovery steps shall be limited to ten seconds.
If recovery fails, the terminal shall release the session.
If recovery fails, the terminal shall send a SessionRequest message after one minute.
